description: Open a chat. kind 'direct': the chat with one colleague ('with') — there is one per pair, so an existing one is found rather than made ('created' false). kind 'group': a group with a title and its members, you its administrator. kind 'agent': a chat of your own with one of the company's agents ('agent', e.g. 'product'), found if you have one. Only the company's own people. A project's chat is never made — it is there for every project; list_chats with projectKey finds it.

agent.description: For 'agent': the agent's role key or handle, e.g. 'product' or 'agent:product'.

members.description: For 'group': the members besides you, by username or email.

with.description: For 'direct': the colleague's username or email.

name: create_chat
title: Create chat
